transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

I’ve been having a lot of trouble with my sleep. It’s gotten really messed up lately—some nights I’m up half the night with my mind just running, and other times I wake up way too early and feel like I didn’t rest at all.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially around the time your sleep problems started?

Yeah… I have. Lately I’ve been waking up with this really heavy, empty feeling. Like, I’ll be sitting in my condo—the place I worked so hard to get—and instead of feeling proud or comfortable, I just feel like I want to cry.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest or pleasure in most activities, even ones you used to enjoy?
Yeah, I have. I used to go to salsa class, and I just stopped going. And I have my paints sitting out on the table, but I just look at them and feel nothing… like they belong to somebody else.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just at certain times or in certain situations?

Yeah… it’s been most of the day, most days lately. I wake up already feeling heavy and empty, and it kind of stays with me. Even being in my own condo, which I worked so hard for, I just feel like crying instead of feeling good about it.
Has this depressed mood been going on for at least 2 years, or is it something that has developed more recently?
It’s more recent than that. I’d say this depressed, guilty fog has been around for about five months now… but it got a lot worse after I bought the condo.
Before these five months of feeling depressed, were you feeling down or having low periods most days for a lot of the time, even before buying the condo?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had bad days before, but I don’t think it was most days for a long time like this. This feels more like something that really set in recently.
Have you ever had a period of time before this recent five months where you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks or more?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember a time before this where it was most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks. I’ve had rough patches, but nothing that clearly stands out like this.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually high, elated, or extremely energetic, where you were doing things more than usual or felt like you didn’t need much sleep?

Yeah… earlier this month I had a stretch where I felt really energized, almost lit up, like I could handle anything. But I was also more short-tempered. I snapped at my mom and even my supervisor over small questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.
How long did you feel that unusually energized and 'lit up' mood, where you snapped at people and felt like you could handle anything?
It was part of this up-and-down thing that’s been really noticeable for about a month now, since the mortgage became real. The charged-up feeling would come in stretches, and then I’d crash after.
How many days in a row did you feel that unusually energized and 'lit up' mood, where you felt like you could handle anything and didn’t need much sleep?

I can’t pin it down to an exact number of days in a row. The really noticeable back-and-forth between feeling charged up like that and then crashing has been going on for about a month, since the mortgage stuff became real.
Can you think of a time when you felt that unusually energized, 'lit up' mood for four days or more without it being interrupted by feelings of depression or crashing?

I don’t know if I can say it was four full days straight without any crash. What I can say is the really obvious back-and-forth between that charged-up feeling and crashing has been going on about a month, since the mortgage became real.
Can you think of any time when you felt that unusually energized, 'lit up' mood for at least four days straight, even if it later switched to feeling down or crashing afterward?

I’m still not totally sure about four days straight. What I know is the really clear cycling — that charged-up stretch and then the crash — has been going on for about a month, since the mortgage became real.
Can you think of any time in the past when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four days in a row, even if it was followed by a crash or feeling down?

I’m not sure I can clearly say there was a full four days in a row. What I do know is that the obvious cycling between feeling really charged up and then crashing has been going on for about a month, since the mortgage became real.
Can you think of any time in your life when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four days in a row, even if it was followed by a crash or feeling down?

Earlier this month there were definitely times I felt almost lit up, like unstoppable. I don’t know if I can pin it down perfectly as four days, but that feeling was there, and I’d get really irritable too — like snapping at my mom or my supervisor over little questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.
Can you think of any time in the past when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four consecutive days, even if it was followed by a crash or feeling down?

Yeah, earlier this month I did have times where I felt almost lit up, like I could just keep going and nothing could stop me. I can’t say for sure it was exactly four days in a row, but it was noticeable. And I got really irritable with it too — I’d snap at my mom or my supervisor over small questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.
Can you think of a time when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four consecutive days, even if it was followed by a crash or feeling down?

Yeah, I think earlier this month was the closest. I felt almost lit up, like really unstoppable, and then I’d get irritated fast — snapping at my mom or my supervisor over little questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.

Can you recall if there was a specific period lasting at least four consecutive days when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high, where your mood was elevated or irritable and you felt like you didn’t need much sleep or could take on a lot of things?

I think earlier this month is the period I’d point to. I felt really lit up, like I could handle anything, almost unstoppable. And my mood was kind of edgy too — I’d snap at my mom or my supervisor over little questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.

Can you confirm if there was a specific time when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four days in a row, where you felt like you didn’t need much sleep and were taking on a lot of things, even if you were also irritable during that time?

Yeah, earlier in the month is the time I’m thinking of. I felt really lit up, like unstoppable, and I was taking on things like I could just handle it all. I was also pretty irritable — I’d snap at my mom or my supervisor over small questions that normally wouldn’t bother me.

Can you confirm if there was a time when you felt unusually energized, 'lit up,' or high for at least four consecutive days, where your mood was elevated or irritable and you felt like you didn’t need much sleep or could take on a lot of things?

Yes, earlier this month. That’s the time I mean. I felt kind of lit up, like I was unstoppable, and then I’d get really irritated and snap at my mom or my supervisor over little questions that usually wouldn’t bother me.
